# Lumen snapshot

LumenTokens and LumenUI are copied without source changes from local Lumen
revision d10900ada6ecc7001460bf2aff40ae1bddef626d. The package manifest is
reduced to the two products used by AIRS; catalog, examples, tests, research
captures and development files are excluded.

Lumen and AIRS share the same owner. On 2026-10-19 the owner confirmed
authorship of both and authorized including Lumen with AIRS for distribution.
No standalone open-source license is assigned by this snapshot.
